summary: Anna Laila Leikvold (22) was struck and killed by a football-sized rock dislodged by climbers above while at the base of Wizard's Gate crag; 911 was called and rescuers arrived with a litter but she died before reaching the ambulance.
location: Wizard's Gate, Twin Sisters Peak (south of Estes Park)
notes: ANAC 2023 edition (Pub 2023); incident date Jul 9 per article.
